diffs.diff: pin count: part has 7 (GND PWM DIR POWER+ POWER- MOTOR_A MOTOR_B), datasheet reading has 3 (GND PWM DIR)
diffs.evidence: The second reading listed only the 3-pin control header (1 GND, 2 PWM, 3 DIR), but the MD10C R3.0 manual also defines the power terminal block (1 'V motor Power +', 2 'Negative Supply or Ground terminal') and the motor terminal block (3 'Connect to motor terminal A', 4 'Connect to motor terminal B'), which the model includes as POWER+, POWER-, MOTOR_A and MOTOR_B.
